_about: Keyword rules for evaluate.py. Rules run in order. Tags add up from every rule that matches; the label comes from the FIRST matching rule that has one. A rule with label null only adds tags. 'in' says what text is searched: title, categories, location, or text (title + categories + location). Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions. 'sources' / 'not_sources' limit a rule to source groups below or source ids.
